Maya K: Morning — quick async for gateway/routing/auth/rate-limits
Maya K: Yesterday: landed PR #4582 to add prefix-based routing for /v2/ customers + unit tests. Hooked up basic integration playbook.
Maya K: Blocker: seeing intermittent 429s in staging when we hit ~1.2k rps. Pattern looks like short burst followed by token-bucket exhaustion on a few routes.
Maya K: Today: add per-route queue depth metrics, run a targeted canary with reduced burst capacity and smaller refill (proposed values below). @Liam T @Anika S can you eyeball config?
Liam T: Saw the 429s, reproduced locally with a small k6 script. Quick patch: bumped per-route concurrency from 50 -> 80 in staging helm values so we don't throttle short bursts immediately.
Liam T: Helm snippet: ```yaml
gateway:
  routes:
    /v2/achieve:
      concurrency: 80
      rate_limit:
        unit: second
        requests: 200
        burst: 400
```
Jorge R: I can run a load test at 11:30 PT against staging once you have the new helm values. Will capture p95/p99 and queue depth. @sre-bot can you stand by for the load window?
sre-bot: Scheduled load window 11:30 PT -> 11:50 PT. Will capture metrics, create perf artifacts.
Anika S: Quick review on PR #4582: LGTM mostly, left one nit about log context for route_id (helps postmortems). Also flagged that auth middleware doesn't pre-warm keys during rollout — could cause extra latency on first requests after JWT rotation.
Maya K: Good catch on pre-warm. Proposed canary config for today: token_bucket: { refill: 150, capacity: 600 } and canary_pct: 10% -> 25% after 20 mins if stable.
Maya K: Prometheus expr I'll add for queue depth: `sum(rate(gateway_route_queue_length[1m])) by (route)` and alert if p95 queue length > 50.
Liam T: FYI I pushed a branch with pre-warm logic for auth keys (PR #4590). It fetches new keys asynchronously before swapping. Canary that with the gateway changes.
Anika S: If JWT rotation is scheduled for tomorrow, request we postpone until post-canary. I messaged security to propose a 2h delay window.
sre-bot: Alert: stg-gateway-429-spike detected at 10:05 UTC. Peak 1.4k rps, created incident INC-2026-06-15-01.
Maya K: Thanks — @Jorge R once you run the load test please attach the k6 output + grafana snapshots to PR #4582 and #4590. Also ping reviewers for #4590 (auth pre-warm).
Jorge R: Will do, uploading artifacts after test. Expect a short follow-up thread with traces.
devops-bot: Deploy: canary roll (10%) of gateway image redwood/gateway:v3.2.1 started at 10:05 UTC.
Maya K: TL;DR / action items: (1) @Liam T update staging helm with new concurrency/burst (done), (2) @Jorge R run load at 11:30 and attach logs, (3) @Anika S coordinate JWT rotation delay with Security, (4) me will add the queue-depth alert + bump canary to 25% if stable. Ping here after artifacts and I'll merge. :thumbsup:
Liam T: I'll also add a small smoke test to CI to hit /v2/ prefix under burst patterns. PR incoming (#4595).
Anika S: ACK — reviewing #4590 now.
Maya K: thanks everyone, will reconvene if alerts persist.
